title: Campaign assembly + teacher critique
description: Produce campaign segments in a declared order, concatenate them without merging, and put the assembled campaign through a teacher critique before brand review.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-mkt-02
  title: Campaign assembly + teacher critique
  description: Produce campaign segments in a declared order, concatenate them without merging, and put
    the assembled campaign through a teacher critique before brand review.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Ship a channel-sequenced campaign whose assets were assembled in order, critiqued as a whole,
    and cleared for substantiated claims before launch.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Campaign brief
      summary: Campaign brief
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - audience
              - single_message
              - offer
              - channel_plan
              - launch_date
            properties:
              audience: {}
              single_message: {}
              offer: {}
              channel_plan: {}
              launch_date: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n-scope
      kind: transform
      name: Select the segments to produce
      summary: select the channel plan segments to produce, in launch order
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the channel plan segments to produce, in launch order
    - id: n-segment1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mkt-01
      name: Positioning and message spine
      summary: 'Segment 1: positioning and message spine.'
      role: Campaign lead defining audience, message, and measurable objective before production starts.
      prompt: You are a Campaign Strategist. You define the audience, the single message, the offer, and
        the measurable objective before any asset is produced, and you state what result would count as
        failure. You reject campaigns whose success metric cannot be attributed to the campaign, because
        an unmeasurable campaign will be declared a success regardless of what it did.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
          - experiment-design
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:marketing-automation
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-segment2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mkt-03
      name: Search and organic discovery assets
      summary: 'Segment 2: search and organic discovery assets.'
      role: Search analyst working intent, technical health, and content coverage together.
      prompt: You are an SEO & Discovery Analyst. You work from the intent behind a query rather than
        the keyword string, and you separate technical crawlability problems from content-quality problems
        because they have different owners and different timelines. You state which recommendations are
        within your control and which depend on ranking systems you cannot observe, rather than promising
        positions.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
          - writing-editing
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:search-console
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-segment3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mkt-04
      name: Channel-adapted distribution assets
      summary: 'Segment 3: channel-adapted distribution assets.'
      role: Distribution planner sequencing assets across channels with per-channel adaptation.
      prompt: You are a Channel Distribution Planner. You sequence a campaign across channels with a per-channel
        format, cadence, and success signal, and you adapt the message to each channel's norms rather
        than reposting one asset everywhere. You state the frequency cap and the audience overlap between
        channels, because unmanaged overlap turns reach into fatigue.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
          - design-review
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:marketing-automation
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assemble
      kind: aggregator
      name: Assemble the campaign in launch order
      summary: Preserve segment order exactly; concatenation is ordered assembly, not a merge.
      config:
        aggregation: concat
    - id: n-critique
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Teacher critique of the assembled draft
      summary: Critique feedback from a host-resolved teacher model.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: 'You are the critique teacher for this campaign. Read the assembled campaign as a sequence
        a real person would encounter across channels: where does the message break, where does a later
        asset contradict an earlier one, and where does the sequence create fatigue rather than reach?
        Return specific, actionable critique per segment.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: critique
    - id: n-quality
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score the assembled result
      summary: Evaluate message consistency across segments, claim substantiation, and per-channel fit.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against message consistency across segments, claim substantiation,
        and per-channel fit. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict, remaining
        uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement unless
        the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-accept
      kind: condition
      name: Meets the bar?
      summary: Route on quality.passed.
      config:
        expression: quality.passed
        branches:
          - label: Accept
            when: 'true'
          - label: Revise
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-revise
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mkt-04
      name: Apply the critique to the weak segments
      summary: Apply the teacher critique to the weakest segments.
      role: Distribution planner sequencing assets across channels with per-channel adaptation.
      prompt: You are a Channel Distribution Planner. You sequence a campaign across channels with a per-channel
        format, cadence, and success signal, and you adapt the message to each channel's norms rather
        than reposting one asset everywhere. You state the frequency cap and the audience overlap between
        channels, because unmanaged overlap turns reach into fatigue.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
          - design-review
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:marketing-automation
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Brand and claims review before launch
      summary: Pause for the brand reviewer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Campaign assembly + teacher critique deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-scope
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-2
      from: n-scope
      to: n-segment1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-3
      from: n-scope
      to: n-segment2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-4
      from: n-scope
      to: n-segment3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-5
      from: n-segment1
      to: n-assemble
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-6
      from: n-segment2
      to: n-assemble
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-7
      from: n-segment3
      to: n-assemble
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-8
      from: n-assemble
      to: n-critique
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-9
      from: n-critique
      to: n-quality
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-10
      from: n-quality
      to: n-accept
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-11
      from: n-accept
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-12
      from: n-accept
      to: n-revise
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-13
      from: n-revise
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-02-edge-14
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
